question: List, in order, the heat treatments the NiTi wire and its vanadium oxide coating went through, with temperatures and times.
expect: aging at 600 °C for 1 h under vacuum (p6.L57-58); ALD at a reaction temperature of 200 °C (precursor 55 °C, manifolds 115 °C) (p6.L71-76); annealing at 450 °C for 30 min in air (p6.L83)
rendered:
According to the document, the heat treatments the NiTi wire and its vanadium oxide coating went through are as follows:

1. Aging process at 600 °C for 1 h under vacuum in a Lindberg Blue 1″ Quartz CVD tube furnace.
2. Annealing treatment at 450 °C for 30 min in a Lindberg Blue 1″ Quartz CVD tube furnace open to air to achieve crystalline coatings of vanadium pentoxide (V2O5) on the surface of the alloy.

Note that the document also mentions that the precursor, (98+%) Vanadium(V)tri-i-propoxy oxide (VTIP), was preheated to 55 °C, but this is not a heat treatment of the NiTi wire or its vanadium oxide coating, but rather a step in the atomic layer deposition (ALD) process.
